data.one_liner: Merges firebase_messaging and flutter_local_notifications for handling FCM notifications.
data.what_it_does: Merges the firebase_messaging package and flutter_local_notifications to make handling, displaying, and interacting with FCM notifications easier. It provides widgets and mixins to listen to incoming notifications and notification taps, as well as handling background messages.
use_when: You want to display FCM notifications while the app is in the foreground using local notifications.
You need an easier way to handle incoming notification events and notification clicks anywhere in your app.
avoid_when: You only need basic background messaging without local notification UI rendering.
You prefer to manually wire up flutter_local_notifications and firebase_messaging yourself.
strengths: Simplifies foreground notification display for Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Provides mixins and widgets like FCMNotificationListener and FCMNotificationMixin for easy handling.
Supports Android, iOS, macOS, and Web platforms.
weaknesses: Requires manual native setup steps for Android, iOS, macOS, and Web as documented by Firebase.
Limited documentation outside of basic setup and listener examples.
data.setup_notes: Requires following Firebase installation guides for Android, iOS, macOS, and Web, adding meta-data to AndroidManifest.xml, and adding firebase-messaging-sw.js for web.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want official Firebase messaging support without the local notification wrapper layer.

alternatives.name: flutter_local_notifications
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a dedicated local notifications plugin without Firebase integration.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using OneSignal instead of Firebase for push notifications.
